Botanica Skyport

Villa in Nai Yang (Sakhu)
HomeSaleBotanica Skyport

Marketing images from the developer website, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A boutique collection of five Bali-inspired pool villas by Botanica Luxury Phuket on a site of about 3,000 sqm in Sakhu, Thalang. All five are three-bedroom, four-bathroom homes with private pools, with built-up areas of 340 to 361 sqm and land plots of about 479 to 618 sqm.

The site is about 2 km from Phuket International Airport and around 2.6 km from Nai Yang Beach, and near Blue Canyon Golf Club. Shared features are a communal garden, parking, 24-hour security and CCTV; pets are allowed.

Completion is not confirmed by the sources used here (another listing says 2027). Ownership is not confirmed, so check the title type with the developer.
